2609.26658.title: Discovery-Driven Integration of Disjoint Tables via Text
2609.26658.paper_summary: Integrating heterogeneous datasets within data lakes is a critical challenge, particularly for semantically related tables that lack the explicit attributes needed to be joined. We study Discovery-Driven Integration, where the relevant sources and their missing relational structure must be discovered before integration. In this setting, unstructured text provides the evidence that connects otherwise disjoint tables. The fundamental challenge is to discover the relationships at a fine-grained level that connect individual rows from different tables through specific sentences. We formalize this task as Text-Mediated Join Path Discovery and propose a horizontal bidirectional cross-attention architecture called LOKI Latent-space Optimization for Knowledge Integration) that learns contextualized representations of table rows and sentences. Through a global table-text contrastive objective, fine-grained row-sentence associations emerge without explicit local supervision. Existing multi-modal discovery methods largely retrieve coarse-grained column-text associations, whereas integration systems assume supplied row-text links, schemas, or queries. LOKI instead transforms these implicit associations into explicit, interpretable join paths, organizes them into relation-consistent groups, and materializes them as typed integrated tables with sentence-level provenance. Comprehensive evaluations on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that LOKI consistently outperforms state-of-the-art multi-modal data discovery approaches, and materializes typed integrated tables with 0.982 macro typed-pair precision while being up to 40 times cheaper in LLM API cost than direct prompting.
2609.26658.paper_summary_zh: 整合數據湖中的異質數據集是一個關鍵挑戰，特別是對於缺乏明確屬性以進行聯接的語義相關表格。我們研究以發現驅動的整合，相關來源及其缺失的關聯結構必須在整合之前被發現。在這種情況下，非結構化文本提供了連接本來不相交的表格的證據。根本挑戰在於發現以細粒度水平連接不同表格中個別行的關係，通過特定的句子。我們將這一任務形式化為文本介導的聯接路徑發現，並提出一種名為LOKI（潛在空間優化知識整合）的水平雙向交叉注意力架構，該架構學習表格行和句子的上下文化表示。通過全球表格-文本對比目標，細粒度的行-句子關聯在沒有明確的局部監督下出現。現有的多模態發現方法主要檢索粗粒度的列-文本關聯，而整合系統假設提供的行-文本鏈接、架構或查詢。LOKI則將這些隱式關聯轉化為明確的、可解釋的聯接路徑，將它們組織成關係一致的組，並將其具現化為具有句子級來源的類型化整合表格。在現實世界基準上的全面評估顯示，LOKI始終超越最先進的多模態數據發現方法，並以0.982的宏觀類型對精度具現化類型化整合表格，同時在LLM API成本上比直接提示便宜多達40倍。
